notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks for everyone’s feedback and evaluations. We've made the following changes to the game:

Fixed the issue where clicking on fragments could inadvertently move the screen.
Reduced the detection range for fragments.
Resolved the issue with the cat being obscured.
We’ll soon add the functionality to advance to the next level after completing a level, toggle the cat’s visibility, and introduce more level types. Thanks again, everyone!
